items.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017
items.q: I worked with that man 18 years, 18 long God damn days man, or years, I worked with him.

ctx.x: He almost didn’t give you a chance to say no, right?

No. Well I’ll tell you, I worked with that man 18 years, 18 long God damn days man, or years, I worked with him. And I remember we came from overseas, we had been on a trip like Germany, Switzerland, I can’t remember some of the other places right now. But anyway, we came back and I think we were coming to the Port Authority, so he was walking with his wife, and I walked up there and I said, “Hamp,” I said, “Listen man, I’m putting my notice in.” And he said, “Aw, Gates” he said. And he laughed, ha, ha. He said,…
Was this — I can almost picture it. Was this the big band or was it a smaller group?
